name: Top Bar
description: Custom menu bar with dropdown menus (File, View, Tools, Help) and a theme toggle button. File: Open Workspace, Exit. View: Terminal submenu (New + instance list with focus/reopen), Explorer, Git, Markdown, Canvas grid submenu (Dots/Grid/None), Zoom submenu (In/Out/Reset/Lock). Tools: SpecsMap, Theme. Help: Tutorial, About. Supports keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Escape) and hover-to-open behavior with 300ms close delay. Dynamically patches Terminal, Git, and SpecsMap instance submenus via setTerminalItems/setGitItems/setSpecsmapItems.
